youtube_title: Resurrection Mary: the ghost who asks for a ride on Archer Avenue
body: She asks you for a ride home. Then, at the cemetery gates, she's gone. On Archer Avenue, southwest of Chicago, drivers have told this story since the 1930s. Legend says she's a young blond woman, dressed for dancing, near the old Oh Henry Ballroom. She asks for a ride up Archer, and when the car reaches Resurrection Cemetery, the seat is empty. Some drivers say they hit a woman on Archer, and when they stopped, no one was there. In August 1976, a police officer found two bars of the cemetery gate bent and scorched; a worker later said a truck had backed into it. Who was she? No one has ever proven it. But the legend says she's still waiting for a ride. 👻 Comment your town, and it could be next! #ResurrectionMary #Chicago #ArcherAvenue #Illinois #Haunted #Legend #LaPorteAfterDark
